run_compute_bleu: run the script to compute BLEU scores on generated text samples from a checkpoint directory
run_eval_samples: run the eval_samples function to evaluate generated samples against ground truth and log BLEU scores
run_group_samples: run the group_samples function to group generated and ground truth texts by ground truth
review_eval_samples: review the eval_samples function that computes BLEU scores and n-gram precision for generated text
review_group_samples: review the group_samples function that groups samples by decoded ground truth text
